title: VP Global Supply chain and manufacturing
text:
At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 270+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Global Supply Chain to lead the strategy and execution of our end-to-end global supply chain, including procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, inventory planning, logistics, and warehouse operations. This executive will build scalable capabilities that support company growth, successful installations, and reliable field service across multiple geographies, with accountability for delivery performance, cost, working capital, and supply continuity.

This role requires a strategic, hands-on leader who can set long-term direction while working directly with teams and suppliers to negotiate critical agreements, resolve material constraints, and improve operational performance. Partnering closely with the COO and executive leadership team, the VP will align supply chain priorities with business objectives, strengthen planning and operational visibility, and develop a high-performing organization with clear ownership and measurable results.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

* Set the global supply chain strategy. Develop and execute a multiyear roadmap aligned with growth plans, installation requirements, service commitments, and financial objectives.
* Own operational and financial performance. Establish accountability for total supply chain cost, inventory investment, delivery reliability, and warehouse productivity. Partner with Finance to develop budgets, evaluate investments, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Connect business demand with supply execution. Establish a cross-functional planning cadence that aligns forecasts, installation schedules, field service requirements, supplier capacity, and inventory availability. Surface constraints early and drive decisions that protect customer commitments.
* Lead strategic sourcing and supplier performance. Develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial agreements, and build supplier relationships that improve cost, quality, lead times, and capacity. Hold suppliers accountable through clear expectations and performance reviews.
* Build supply resilience. Identify critical dependencies and develop mitigation plans for supplier disruption, capacity constraints, long lead times, and cross-border risks.
* Optimize inventory and material availability. Establish inventory policies that balance installation and service readiness with working capital discipline, reducing shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence.
* Direct global logistics and warehouse operations. Design scalable distribution capabilities and oversee freight, import/export, fulfillment, and material flow to installation sites and field teams. Ensure safe, accurate, compliant, and efficient operations.
* Strengthen systems, data, and decision-making. Set standards for ERP data integrity, inventory visibility, and reporting. Prioritize improvements in systems and automation that support scale and better operational decisions.
* Build and develop the organization. Define the team structure, hire and develop strong leaders, establish succession plans, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as an executive business partner. Present performance, risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations to senior leadership. Align stakeholders around decisions that improve customer outcomes and support sustainable growth.

 
Requirements:
 

* 15+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 7 years in senior leadership roles overseeing multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographies. Demonstrated accountability for enterprise supply chain strategy, financial performance, and organizational development is required; prior VP-level or equivalent executive leadership experience is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* A hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to set strategic direction while directly engaging in critical supplier negotiations, resolving material shortages, improving warehouse and logistics processes, and supporting installation and field service readiness.
* Experience leading complex supply chains across multiple geographies, including procurement, supplier management, inventory, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* A track record of scaling operations and delivering measurable improvements in cost, delivery performance, inventory efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, working capital management, supplier negotiations, and investment evaluation.
* Experience establishing cross-functional planning processes that align demand, supply, and operational execution.
* Working knowledge of international trade, import/export compliance, and cross-border logistics.
* Experience using ERP systems and operational analytics to improve visibility, controls, and performance, with the ability to work directly with data to diagnose issues and drive corrective action; NetSuite experience is preferred.
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders, make decisions amid uncertainty, and translate strategy into clear priorities and accountable execution.
* Ability to develop strong leaders, delegate effectively, and build team capability while remaining actively engaged in operational performance.
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15% to support installation sites, operational locations, and supplier visits, including locations in Indiana, Canada, and Mexico.

Ideally, we’re looking for:

* VP / Director-level or equivalent leadership experience in a high-growth business with complex installation, deployment, or field service requirements.
* Experience supporting both project-based material demand and ongoing service or spare-parts needs.
* Success transforming a supply chain organization through direct involvement in process improvements, stronger planning, leadership development, and systems implementation.
* Experience expanding supplier and distribution capabilities into new geographies.
* A strategic, hands-on leader who is comfortable working alongside teams in warehouses, at installation sites, and with suppliers to understand challenges, remove barriers, and deliver results.

Benefits we offer:

* Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision.
* Company 401k Match.
* 20 PTO days, company-paid holidays.
* Career growth as we scale across the US.

Compensation:

UVeye provides salary ranges that comply with the New Jersey State Law on salary transparency in job advertisements. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, skills, location, education, and operational needs. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentives or other forms of compensation or benefits. The annual base salary range for this position is $250,000 – $280,000.

Physical Requirements & Travel:

This role may involve on-site or field-based activities. Depending on the position, tasks may include extended periods of sitting, standing, or walking; working in and around vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, or warehouse environments; The role may also require travel, working in varying environmental conditions, and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) when appropriate. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

Why UVeye

 

* Tech-First Mindset: Join a team at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge technology is shaping the future of AI and redefining the automotive industry.
* Industry Leadership: Be part of a trailblazing company driving real change—backed by rapid growth, a track record of success, and strong partnerships with global industry leaders.
* People-Centered Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values initiative, supports growth, and provides unique opportunities for development through executive workshops and mentorship programs.

UVeye is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
